# CardActions

Actions area of card

## Overview

- **Category**: surfaces
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: CardActions

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { CardActions } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<CardActions>
  <Button size="small">Action</Button>
</CardActions>
```

## Examples

```tsx
<CardActions>
  <Button size="small">Action</Button>
</CardActions>
```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's CardActions.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:

- [MUI CardActions Documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/api/cardactions/)
